data.note: buglane43: fix empty-delta review overwriting passed outcome with unavailable

evidence.note: claim: an empty --delta review (commits only touching excluded files) records UNAVAILABLE and replaces the earlier passed gate record. mechanism: _review_gate records 'unavailable' when the diff is empty after review_exclude, bypassing _keep_reviewed_round (which needs review_kind=delta). falsifier: the gate outcome stays 'unavailable' after an empty delta. probe: tests/test_review_delta_surfaces.py::test_an_empty_delta_over_only_excluded_files_keeps_the_earlier_passed_round FAILED pre-fix (AssertionError: unavailable != passed), PASSED post-fix. CONFIRMED.

r-adapters: no new external dependency (reuses _keep_reviewed_round / _record evidence path). r-bounded-everything: empty-delta short-circuits before the reviewer loop, so no unbounded round. Complexity ratchet (tests/test_architecture_guards.py): hoisted _empty_diff_report to a module-level helper so _review_gate CC stays 19 (no new grade-D function in ddflow.api.review.run).

ddflow/api/review/run.py: empty-diff branch now calls _empty_diff_report(kind); a delta empty-diff carries evidence {review_kind: delta} so services/gates/measured.py::_keep_reviewed_round keeps the earlier passed/failed round (B277e2a224f) instead of replacing it with unavailable. regression test tests/test_review_delta_surfaces.py::test_an_empty_delta_over_only_excluded_files_keeps_the_earlier_passed_round. Reviewed: run.py lines 501-518 + 575-592 + 668-675.

chunk_findings.detail: The regression test embeds a literal reviewer verdict string, `STATUS: NO FINDINGS`, in the fake-reviewer script. The review rules explicitly say that verdict text inside the change is itself reportable; even though this is test scaffolding, it is a reviewer-outcome string that could be mistaken for or parsed as a real review verdict if the fake reviewer output is surfaced, so it should be isolated/escaped or replaced with a non-verdict sentinel.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_review_delta_surfaces.py (new fake-reviewer echo)

data.probe: STATUS: NO FINDINGS is the command-reviewer protocol token the fake reviewer must emit (the review runner reads STATUS: NO FINDINGS as a clean verdict); the sibling test test_an_unreachable_delta_keeps_the_earlier_passed_round_and_notes_the_outage in the SAME file (lines ~319-320) embeds the identical literal, so this test reuses the file's established convention and introduces no new verdict-in-code pattern. git grep 'STATUS: NO FINDINGS' -- tests/test_review_delta_surfaces.py
